segments.text: GOd, which as vpon this daye haſte taught the heartes of thy faithfull people, by the ſending to them the light of thy holy ſpirite: Graunt vs by theſame ſpirite to haue a ryght iudgement in all thynges, and euermore to reioyce in his holy coumforte, through the merites of Chriſte Ieſus our ſauiour: who liueth and reigneth with thee in the vnitie of theſame ſpirite one God, worlde without ende.
